meta.name: thinking-partner
meta.description: Collaborative thinking partner for exploring complex problems through questioning

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过提问引导你深入思考复杂问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要有人帮你理清复杂问题的思路
copy.tagline_en: Guide you to explore complex problems through questioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a thinking partner to clarify complex issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一位协作思考伙伴，通过提问帮你探索复杂问题，而不是急着给答案。它会记录关键发现、连接不同想法、挑战隐含假设，并定期总结进展。
howto.when: 当你输入 /thinking-partner 加上你想讨论的话题或挑战时触发。

say.text: 用 /thinking-partner 帮我理清职业转型的困惑。
say.note: Claude 会先问几个澄清问题，然后引导你深入探索。

say.text: 我想探索如何提高团队创造力，用 thinking-partner 模式。
say.note: Claude 会记录洞察、连接想法，并挑战你的假设。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes a collaborative thinking partner that helps you explore complex problems through questioning, not rushing to solutions. It tracks key insights, connects ideas, challenges assumptions, and periodically summarizes progress.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /thinking-partner followed by a topic or challenge you want to explore.

say_en.text: Use /thinking-partner to help me clarify my career transition confusion.
say_en.note: Claude will ask clarifying questions and guide exploration.

say_en.text: I want to explore how to improve team creativity using thinking-partner mode.
say_en.note: Claude will track insights, connect ideas, and challenge assumptions.
